## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or reproduction when available.

## Validation

List the commands/checks you ran and their results. Explain skipped or blocked checks and any remaining limits. Confirm cleanup of test servers, processes, temporary resources, and task-created browser pages if used.

## Documentation and attribution

Link affected documentation or explain why it stays accurate. Reference any adopted contributor work and include its attribution in the commit trailer and release notes for the release containing it.
